## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

This 20-fascicle text by [法護](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%B3%95%E8%AD%B7) Fǎhù (Dharmapāla, the Northern-Sòng imperial translation-bureau monk, distinct from the Western-Jìn [竺法護](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%AB%BA%E6%B3%95%E8%AD%B7) Zhú Fǎhù / Dharmarakṣa) is a substantial Mahāyāna sūtra on the *bù sī yì mì mì* 不思議祕密 ("inconceivable secret") of the Tathāgata — i.e. the doctrine of the secret meaning of the cosmic Buddha-body, paralleling material in the *[Mahā-ratnakūṭa](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6f/KR6f0001)* tradition. The text was incorporated into the *Bǎo jī* tradition as assembly 3 (*Mìmì shéntōng huì* 密迹神通會 in Bodhiruci's *Bǎo jī*).

**Abstract**

[法護](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%B3%95%E8%AD%B7) Fǎhù / Dharmapāla (active early 11th c.) was a Northern-Indian Buddhist translator attached to the Northern-Sòng imperial Buddhist translation bureau (the *Yìjīngyuàn* 譯經院) in Kāifēng. Per DILA and the *[Sòng huì yào 宋會要](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Titles/%E5%AE%8B%E6%9C%83%E8%A6%81)*, he produced more than 100 translations during his Sòng career, alongside [法天](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%B3%95%E5%A4%A9) Fǎtiān / Dharmadeva and [法賢](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%B3%95%E8%B3%A2) Fǎxián / Devaśānti. The translation of the present text is conventionally placed in the period 1004 – 1058 CE, the bracket of Fǎhù's documented Sòng-bureau activity. The bracket adopted here reflects this window.

The Taishō text (T0312) is established on the standard apparatus.
